title: Goals view - Current and History
description:
Goal
- Present the current macro goal with its micro goals and historical goals via GoalsService.

Current tab
- Show the current macro goal at the top.
- Show active micro goals with the ability to mark complete or incomplete; persist changes via API.
- Below, show past (completed) micro goals for the current macro goal sorted by most recent.

History tab
- Display a date-sorted list of past macro goals; each can be expanded to reveal all micro goals for that macro.

Tech notes
- Use optimistic updates for micro goal completion toggles and reconcile with server responses.
- Ensure sorting matches backend expectations and handle pagination if present.

Acceptance criteria
- Current tab shows macro goal and active micro goals; toggles persist and reflect immediately.
- Past micro goals are listed beneath active ones in correct order.
- History tab expands macro goals to reveal micro goals; ordering is correct.
- Errors and empty states are handled gracefully.

features.title: Current macro and active micro goals
features.description: Fetch the current macro goal and its micro goals via GoalsService. Partition into active vs past. Render a header card for the macro, and a list of active micro goals with key stats.

features.title: Toggle micro goal completion (optimistic)
features.description: Allow toggling complete/incomplete for micro goals with optimistic UI updates. Persist via GoalsService; rollback on failure and show a toast. Acceptance: toggle feels instant and consistent after server reconciliation.

features.title: Past micro goals list
features.description: Display past (completed) micro goals beneath active ones, sorted by most recent. Support pagination if present. Acceptance: ordering correct and list is performant for larger histories.

features.title: History tab - macro goals archive
features.description: Show a date-sorted list of past macro goals. Each item expands to reveal its micro goals. Persist expand/collapse state per session for UX polish (optional).

features.title: Empty, loading, and error states
features.description: Provide skeletons and empty placeholders for both tabs, plus inline error with retry. Acceptance: clear, consistent UX for transient and failure states across goals views.
